Trader consensus at 42.5 % for 19 °C and 32 % for 18 °C captures remaining model spread and the potential for modest afternoon clearing, while lower probabilities for 20 °C or above reflect limited warming potential under the prevailing regime. Final Met Office observations will resolve the market.
